neighbours.label: Red Hat-family package management: the 'dnf'/'yum' command and its install line on Fedora, RHEL or CentOS, as against the same install instructions with apt, brew, pip or other package managers
fire: To get the editor on Fedora 39, simply run sudo dnf install emacs in a terminal.
If you are on CentOS 7, install the library with yum install openssl-devel first.
Users of RHEL 9 should type dnf install python3-pip before running the script.
The guide says: on Fedora Workstation, open a terminal and run sudo dnf upgrade.
For Rocky Linux, the server packages come from dnf install nginx and a restart.
On older Red Hat systems you can add the tool with sudo yum install git.
After a fresh Fedora install, I always run sudo dnf install gcc make cmake.
Our build machines run CentOS, so the Dockerfile uses yum install -y curl.
quiet: To get the editor on Debian 12, simply run sudo apt install emacs in a terminal.
If you are on macOS, install the library with brew install openssl first.
Users of Python 3 should type pip install requests before running the script.
The guide says: on Ubuntu Desktop, open a terminal and run sudo apt upgrade.
For Arch Linux, the server packages come from pacman -S nginx and a restart.
On older Windows systems you can add the tool with the official installer.
After a fresh Debian install, I always run sudo apt install gcc make cmake.
Our build machines run Alpine, so the Dockerfile uses apk add curl.
